    # Defensive accessors with defaults
    grid = observation.get("grid", [])
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0]) if height > 0 else 0
    me = observation.get("player", {})
    x = me.get("x", 0)
    y = me.get("y", 0)

    # best effort: try to move toward nearest objective depending on mode
    mode = observation.get("mode", "resource_collection")

    def in_bounds(nx, ny):
        return 0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height

    best_dx, best_dy = 0, 0

    if mode == "pursuit_evasion":
        # Look for nearest pursuer (negative obstacle) and move away
        best_dist = float('inf')
        for oy in range(height):
            row = grid[oy] if oy < height else []
            for ox in range(width):
                cell = row[ox] if ox < len(row) else None
                if cell == "evader":  # potential threat to us if evader near by
                    dist = abs(ox - x) + abs(oy - y)
                    if dist < best_dist:
                        best_dist = dist
                        dx = x - ox
                        dy = y - oy
                        # step away
                        best_dx = 1 if dx > 0 else (-1 if dx < 0 else 0)
                        best_dy = 1 if dy > 0 else (-1 if dy < 0 else 0)
        if best_dx == 0 and best_dy == 0:
            # no threat found; stay or minor exploration
            best_dx, best_dy = 0, 0

    elif mode == "territory_control":
        # Move toward nearest unclaimed tile or edge of own territory
        target_found = False
        best_dist = float('inf')
        for oy in range(height):
            for ox in range(width):
                cell = grid[oy][ox] if oy < height and ox < len(grid[oy]) else None
                if cell == "unclaimed":
                    dist = abs(ox - x) + abs(oy - y)
                    if dist < best_dist:
                        best_dist = dist
                        dx = ox - x
                        dy = oy - y
                        best_dx = 1 if dx > 0 else (-1 if dx < 0 else 0)
                        best_dy = 1 if dy > 0 else (-1 if dy < 0 else 0)
                        target_found = True
        if not target_found:
            best_dx, best_dy = 0, 0

    else:
        # resource_collection default: move toward nearest resource
        best_dist = float('inf')
        for oy in range(height):
            for ox in range(width):
                cell = grid[oy][ox] if oy < height and ox < len(grid[oy]) else None
                if cell == "resource":
                    dist = abs(ox - x) + abs(oy - y)
                    if dist < best_dist:
                        best_dist = dist
                        dx = ox - x
                        dy = oy - y
                        best_dx = 1 if dx > 0 else (-1 if dx < 0 else 0)
                        best_dy = 1 if dy > 0 else (-1 if dy < 0 else 0)
        if best_dx == 0 and best_dy == 0:
            best_dx, best_dy = 0, 0

    # Clamp to allowed values (redundant but defensive)
    if best_dx not in (-1, 0, 1):
        best_dx = 0
    if best_dy not in (-1, 0, 1):
        best_dy = 0

    return [best_dx, best_dy]
